# memory tools

Shared technical memory store - persistent, evidence-backed facts indexed alongside code.

3 tools. All categories: [MCP Tool Catalog](README.md).

## `create_memory`

Create a persistent, evidence-backed technical memory in the shared memory store.

- Permission: `repository:write`
- Source: [memory/create_memory.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/memory/create_memory.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `type` | string (one of: `architectural-fact`, `gotcha`, `config-behavior`, `api-contract`, `performance-note`) | yes | Memory type classifier - pick the one that best fits the claim being captured. |
| `scope` | string (one of: `global`, `repo`, `file`) | yes | Scope of applicability. global = all repos; repo = single repository; file = single file path. |
| `scope_target` | string or null | no | Repository alias (when scope=repo), repo-relative file path (when scope=file), or null when scope=global. |
| `referenced_repo` | string or null | no | Repository alias for access filtering. |
| `summary` | string | yes | Short, pointer-style claim. |
| `evidence` | array of any or any | yes | List of evidence entries. |
| `body` | string | no | Optional markdown body with additional context (pointers to code, not prose dumps). |

## `delete_memory`

Permanently remove a memory from the store with optimistic concurrency.

- Permission: `repository:write`
- Source: [memory/delete_memory.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/memory/delete_memory.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `memory_id` | string | yes | uuid4 of the memory to delete (from create_memory output or from the memory's frontmatter id field). |
| `expected_content_hash` | string | yes | SHA-256 hash of the memory's current on-disk content for optimistic concurrency. |

## `edit_memory`

Update mutable fields on an existing memory entry with optimistic concurrency.

- Permission: `repository:write`
- Source: [memory/edit_memory.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/memory/edit_memory.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `memory_id` | string | yes | uuid4 of the memory to edit (from create_memory output or from the memory's frontmatter id field). |
| `expected_content_hash` | string | yes | SHA-256 hash of the memory's current on-disk content for optimistic concurrency. |
| `type` | string (one of: `architectural-fact`, `gotcha`, `config-behavior`, `api-contract`, `performance-note`) | yes | Memory type classifier (replaces prior value on successful edit). |
| `scope` | string (one of: `global`, `repo`, `file`) | yes | Scope of applicability (replaces prior value on successful edit). |
| `scope_target` | string or null | no | Repository alias (when scope=repo), repo-relative file path (when scope=file), or null when scope=global. |
| `referenced_repo` | string or null | no | Repository alias for access filtering. |
| `summary` | string | yes | Short, pointer-style claim (replaces prior value on successful edit). |
| `evidence` | array of any or any | yes | List of evidence entries. |
| `body` | string | no | Optional markdown body (replaces prior body on successful edit). |
